thermodynamic_engine: NeqSim PR-EOS 100-Slice Multi-Stream MCHE Enthalpy Pinch
crossover_explanation: At extreme turndown (P10-P25), the actual plant operation shows temperature crossover (minimum approach = -25.06 °C). This confirms historical plant observations where refrigerant composition was not tuned for turndown, causing excessive MCR circulation and severe pinch bottlenecks.
remaining_uncertainties: Unmetered high-pressure motive steam bypass and governor valve balancing leakage (~8-12% delta to header meter)
Missing individual turbine steam tags on high baseload quantiles (P62-P100) requiring reliance on total header meter
Assumed turbine blading isentropic efficiencies (75.2%-78.0%) pending direct OEM field test reports
